questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: As a bachelor student I’m only allowed to take grades courses worth 15 ECTS. Because grad Courses that are 3 credits (all standard courses are 3 credits) counts as 10 ects, while bachelors counts as 7.5, I could only take 1 grad course. This was very disappointing as there was only 1 relevant bachelor in physics that was on my level. All the others were too easy. I therefore had to spent credits on courses that weren’t academically relevant for me since I couldn’t get exemption
